title: State of Uttaranchal v. Balwant Singh Chaufal

content.caseIdentity: State of Uttaranchal v. Balwant Singh Chaufal, (2010) 3 SCC 402
content.facts: The Court addressed misuse of PIL jurisdiction for private or publicity-oriented objectives.
questionsBeforeCourt: What safeguards prevent abuse of public-interest jurisdiction?
content.ratioDecidendi: Courts must verify credentials, motive, substantial public injury and the absence of personal gain before entertaining PIL.
content.holding: Laid down comprehensive 8-point mandatory guidelines for High Courts to filter frivolous, vexatious, or blackmailing PILs.
content.relevance: Mandatory verification guidelines and costs for abuse of PIL process.

evidence.note: Official Supreme Court judgment cites the 2010 decision and describes its PIL-development framework; direct original PDF was not located in this search pass.
